name: Shiranui ~Mashou no Ingoku~
source:
[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai_Shiranui]Shiranui Mai[/url] had been training in practice field back in the mountains. One day, she is attached by a sub-human monster Genan.
She ends up beaten, and humiliated with tentacles. Rape, gangbang, impregnation, childbirth, tentacle! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE021714.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai_Shiranui]不知火舞[/url]一直在山裡的練習場訓練。有一天，她被一隻亞人怪物傑南附身。
她最終遭到毆打，並被觸手羞辱。強姦、輪姦、懷孕、分娩、觸手！
